meta.name: Will & Grace: Homo for the Holidays
meta.description:
Will & Grace · Season 2, Episode 7 · aired 1999-11-25

Jack's mother comes to visit for the holidays, but Will and Grace are surprised to find out she doesn't know Jack is gay.
